messages:
anya: Hey team — customer reported chart legend on the embedded dashboard in their mobile app is assigning colors to the wrong series after a refresh. They see the tooltip values also mismatch the selected series. Repro steps and screenshots below.

mike: Can you drop screenshot + steps? Is this only on iOS or Android?

anya: Screenshot: https://files.redwood.test/xx/legend-misassign-01.png
Repro: 1) Open embed on phone (chrome/android) 2) Switch to compact layout 3) Tap legend entry to highlight series 4) Pull to refresh 5) Legend color swaps to a different series but tooltip still shows old value. Occurs ~60% of the time.

jordan: Thanks. Is this the same customer who hit delayed metrics last week? Could be race between metrics load and legend render.

anya: Different customer. This one also notes that metrics panel sometimes shows stale numbers for ~20s after refresh. Might be two bugs.

kevin: I can try reproducing locally. Which bundle/commit? Any console errors in the screenshot?

anya: No console errors in screenshot. App version: embed v1.4.2, frontend bundle: 2026-03-15-raf. Customer timezone UTC-5.

mike: Possible suspect: our legend component relies on stableSeriesIDs but we recently changed series ordering optimization. If the series array mutates during render the mapping to colors could get out of sync. Patch idea: key the legend entries by series.id instead of index.

linda: Also worth checking the async metrics fetch -> we debounce then setSeries which can reorder results when responses resolve out-of-order. We should add request tokens to ignore stale responses.

anya: Customer impact: UI confusion, says charts "show wrong data" and support escalated. Marking P2 for now. Can eng-oncall triage? @jordan

jordan: Oncall taking it. I'll try to repro on Android emulator now and attach logs. If I can reproduce I'll create a small PR with two fixes: stable keys for legend + response token guard.

deploy-bot: New issue created: https://git.redwood/internal/issues/INF-9843 — assigned to mike and linda.

mike: I'll put up a draft PR with legend key change. If you can share exact series payload shape I can write a unit test.

linda: Sample payload from customer (trimmed):
```
{
  "series": [
    {"id":"cpu","label":"CPU %","values":[...]},
    {"id":"mem","label":"Memory","values":[...]},
    {"id":"req","label":"Req/s","values":[...]}
  ]
}
```

mike: perfect. I'll add snapshot test for compact layout + refresh. ETA for PR: today EOD.

anya: Thanks — I'll keep the customer updated that we're investigating and will push a fix. If anyone repros with iOS let me know.

jordan: Reproduced on emulator with network throttling 3G. Legend keys were shifting when the second series arrived later. Verified that adding request token prevents stale setSeries. Both fixes LGTM locally.

mike: PR merged and deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood/embeds/preview/legend-fix. Please smoke test on Android and iOS compact.

anya: Smoke tested on Android Pixel 4 emulator — looks good, legend maps correctly after refresh, tooltip values match. Let me know when prod deploy scheduled and I'll confirm with customer.

kevin: One follow-up: add a regression e2e test for slow network scenario so this doesn't regress. Filed INF-9851.

anya: Great, I'll close the support ticket after prod deploy. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
